name: Wesley Wang
slogan: Frontend depth, full-stack ownership, and a designer's eye
tips: Press Ctrl / Cmd + P to print this resume

content: Frontend engineer with 14 years of experience, including nearly six years working fully remotely across time zones with a U.S. team. Comfortable owning both frontend and full-stack delivery independently.

Core stack: TypeScript, Angular, Vue 3, Nuxt 4, and Node.js. Over the past year, independently built three full-stack Nuxt 4 applications end to end, covering PostgreSQL schema design and versioned migrations, authentication, layered APIs, data validation, and the complete user interface.
Since late 2024, have delivered production LLM capabilities including AI-generated summaries, structured Markdown output, long-context handling, streaming responses, and access control.
AI is reshaping how software gets built and shipped. I want to stay on the delivery side of that change—combining AI with real products and taking ownership of outcomes from idea to production.

experience.title: Remote Work
experience.description: Transitioned to fully remote work in 2019. Initially worked independently across several client projects, leading frontend architecture and product iteration. Joined a U.S. healthcare data services team in December 2020 and have collaborated with the team remotely ever since.

tips.title: Key Achievements:
content: Long-term owner of a core module in a healthcare intelligence platform and one of the repository's key contributors; led the module's production LLM integration from late 2024 onward.
Built a news and email delivery product from zero to one and maintained it independently, accounting for 95% of all commits in the repository.

While freelancing, led the architecture of a complex browser/server business system, contributed throughout the design-to-delivery lifecycle of a B2B product, and delivered the frontend of a B2C product.
Delivered consistently with distributed, cross-time-zone teams for six consecutive years.

experience.title: Sunlands Online Education
experience.description: Developed internal administration and recruitment onboarding systems. Led a sales analytics platform and contributed to a WeChat Mini Program serving more than 300,000 users.

experience.title: Youlu Finance
experience.description: Owned frontend technology selection and architecture for a lending platform. Led a Vue-based rewrite of the core product and introduced a decoupled frontend/backend architecture, enabling independent frontend releases. Redesigned the development-to-delivery workflow so the team shipped more requirements without sustained overtime. Managed a four-person frontend team.

experience.title: Unisound
experience.description: Developed two K–12 education products spanning student, teacher, WeChat parent, and administration applications. Packaged the teacher app for Android and iOS with Ionic. Built a Node.js-based automated build pipeline that resolved release-cache and test-environment deployment issues.

experience.title: Shanghai Chuanfei Information Technology
experience.description: Delivered the desktop site, mobile site, and administration frontend for an inbound travel platform.

experience.title: Wuhan / Shiyan
experience.description: Graduated from Wuhan Vocational College of Software and Engineering and began my career building Drupal and WordPress themes.

project.title: Independent Full-Stack Projects
project.description: Independently designed and built three full-stack Nuxt 4 applications over the past year, owning everything from the database to the user interface. Coverly is open source.

tips.title: Key Contributions:
content: Designed PostgreSQL schemas and versioned migrations, with a type-safe data access layer built on Drizzle ORM.
Built authentication, administration tools, and business APIs; validated requests and responses with Zod.
Built Coverly, a DOM-based cover and social card editor that does not rely on canvas, with server-side authentication and agent APIs.

project.title: Pharmaceutical Market Access Data Platform
project.intro: U.S. SaaS Data Product · Core Frontend Engineer
project.description: A healthcare intelligence platform supporting pharmaceutical pricing and market access decisions across more than 30 business modules. Made 1,449 commits over four and a half years, including 441 in 2024, and became one of the repository's core contributors.

tips.title: Key Contributions:
content: Long-term owner of the core Analog Analysis module, with 718 commits and more than 3,000 file changes spanning indication filters, primary and secondary endpoints, reimbursement-detail queries, filter refactoring, and workspaces.
Contributed to the design and iteration of Product Landscape, Drug Shortages, Country Guidelines, HTA Browser, International Reference Pricing, and other modules.
Led production LLM delivery within the module from late 2024, including AI-generated summaries, structured Markdown output, long-context truncation, access control, and saved reports.
Integrated Amplitude analytics instrumentation to support product usage analysis.

project.title: Industry News & Email Delivery Product
project.intro: Independently Built from Zero to One
project.description: Initiated and independently delivered the complete frontend for a subscription-based industry news product. Accounted for 739 of the repository's 778 commits (95%) and maintained the product for five and a half years.

tips.title: Key Contributions:
content: Built the user-facing product and administration system, including article publishing and rich-text editing, email subscriptions and delivery, bookmarks, category and keyword search, verification-code login, and account settings.
Established the frontend infrastructure, including routing, state management, HTTP abstractions, multi-environment builds for QA and production, and the styling system.
